title: Telnet Configuration
description: Configure Telnet access and understand why it is insecure.
scenario: Configure Telnet access and understand why it is insecure.

concepts.title: Telnet
concepts.body: Telnet provides remote CLI access but sends everything in plaintext. Only use in lab environments.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# line vty 0 4
SW1(config-line)# transport input telnet

concepts.title: VTY Lines
concepts.body: VTY 0-4 allows 5 concurrent remote sessions. Configure login and password or local authentication.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-line)# login local
SW1(config-line)# transport input telnet

concepts.title: Security Warning
concepts.body: Telnet passwords and data are visible on the wire. Use SSH whenever possible.
